title: A Year of Nothing New

pre.en: What new thing did Bea buy during the year?
pre.zh: 那一年里 Bea 买过一样什么新东西？

intro: 这是一期理财播客：主持人 Neil 采访布里斯托尔的老师 Bea，她整整一年没买过新东西。播客开头先打招呼、介绍嘉宾，结尾有一句告别语。读的时候留意 most of、none of、both、either、neither of：说一群东西里「大部分」「一个也没有」「两个都」「两个里哪个」「两个都不」。

sentences.en: Hello, and welcome to Spend Less, the podcast about keeping your money.
sentences.zh: 大家好，欢迎收听《少花点》，一档教你把钱留住的播客。
sentences.speaker: Neil

sentences.en: I'm Neil Price, and my guest today is Bea Turner.
sentences.zh: 我是 Neil Price，今天的嘉宾是 Bea Turner。

sentences.en: She's a teacher from Bristol, and she didn't buy anything new for a whole year.
sentences.zh: 她是布里斯托尔的一位老师，整整一年没买过一样新东西。

sentences.en: Hi, Neil.
sentences.zh: 你好，Neil。
sentences.speaker: Bea

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请。

sentences.en: I should say, I used to buy a new top every payday.
sentences.zh: 先交代一句，我以前每到发工资那天都要买件新上衣。

sentences.en: So, where did your clothes come from?
sentences.zh: 那你的衣服都是哪儿来的？
sentences.speaker: Neil

sentences.en: Most of them came from friends, charity shops and my two sisters.
sentences.zh: 大部分是朋友给的、慈善商店淘的，还有我两个姐妹的。
sentences.speaker: Bea

sentences.en: Once a month, I'd trade my old tops for my older sister's jumpers.
sentences.zh: 每个月我会拿自己的旧上衣去换姐姐的毛衣。

sentences.en: Did either of them mind?
sentences.zh: 她们俩介意吗？
sentences.speaker: Neil

sentences.en: Not really.
sentences.zh: 不太介意。
sentences.speaker: Bea

sentences.en: But neither of them is my size.
sentences.zh: 可她们俩跟我的尺码都不一样。

sentences.en: One's slightly taller, and the other's far shorter.
sentences.zh: 一个比我稍高，一个比我矮很多。

sentences.en: I also learned to live with one pair of jeans.
sentences.zh: 我也学会了一条牛仔裤穿到底。

sentences.en: And none of my colleagues noticed.
sentences.zh: 结果同事一个都没发现。

sentences.en: None of them?
sentences.zh: 一个都没发现？
sentences.speaker: Neil

sentences.en: And what about the kitchen?
sentences.zh: 那厨房呢？

sentences.en: I did without most of the electric stuff in my kitchen.
sentences.zh: 厨房里的大部分小电器，我都不用了。
sentences.speaker: Bea

sentences.en: I even gave the toaster to my neighbour.
sentences.zh: 连烤面包机都送给了邻居。

sentences.en: Looking back, both the toaster and the coffee machine were a waste of money.
sentences.zh: 现在回头看，烤面包机和咖啡机都是白花钱。

sentences.en: I cooked everything in one old pan.
sentences.zh: 我什么都拿一口旧锅做。

sentences.en: It's made of iron, and it's older than me.
sentences.zh: 是口铁锅，岁数比我还大。

sentences.en: And money for fun?
sentences.zh: 那玩乐的钱呢？
sentences.speaker: Neil

sentences.en: I gave myself £20 a month for fun stuff, and I got by.
sentences.zh: 我每个月给自己留 20 英镑玩，也就这么过来了。
sentences.speaker: Bea

sentences.en: I got into the habit of checking the library first.
sentences.zh: 我养成了想要什么先去图书馆看看的习惯。

sentences.en: And I got into board games.
sentences.zh: 还迷上了桌游。

sentences.en: So what was the hardest moment?
sentences.zh: 那最难熬的是什么时候？
sentences.speaker: Neil

sentences.en: December.
sentences.zh: 十二月。
sentences.speaker: Bea

sentences.en: There was a huge sale, and I was really tempted to break the rule.
sentences.zh: 那时候有个大促销，我是真想破一次戒。

sentences.en: My friends said, "Go on, treat yourself, it's Christmas."
sentences.zh: 朋友们都说：「去吧，犒劳一下自己，过圣诞呢。」

sentences.en: Instead, I saved up for a second-hand bike.
sentences.zh: 结果我没买，而是攒钱买了一辆二手自行车。

sentences.en: And on New Year's Day, I set off along the river on it.
sentences.zh: 元旦那天，我骑着它沿着河出发了。

sentences.en: Brilliant.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。
sentences.speaker: Neil

sentences.en: Last question: did you buy anything new at all?
sentences.zh: 最后一个问题：你真的一样新东西都没买吗？

sentences.en: OK, one thing.
sentences.zh: 好吧，买过一样。
sentences.speaker: Bea

sentences.en: A book called How to Stop Buying Things.
sentences.zh: 一本书，书名叫《如何停止买东西》。

sentences.en: Of course you did.
sentences.zh: 果然。
sentences.speaker: Neil

sentences.en: That's all for this week.
sentences.zh: 本周节目就到这里。

sentences.en: Keep your wallet closed, and see you next time.
sentences.zh: 把钱包捂紧，我们下期见。

cards.note: 做播客的人叫 podcaster；听播客是 listen to a podcast。
英国很多公司按月发工资，月底那天就是 payday。
to give something to someone and get something else from them in return
cards.tip: for 后面是换来的东西；跟谁换用 with：trade seats with sb。trade 也是「贸易」，这里是口语里的「换」。
cards.example: I traded my old guitar for a bike.

cards.zh: 学会接受（不理想的情况）
cards.note: to accept something that is not perfect because you cannot change it
cards.tip: learn 的过去式英式常写 learnt，learned 也对；with 后面接名词。
cards.example: The flat is small, but we've learned to live with it.

cards.note: 比 workmate 正式一点。

cards.zh: 没有（某物）也行；将就着不用
cards.note: to manage without having something
cards.tip: 常和 can 连用：I can't do without coffee（离不开咖啡）。
cards.example: We can do without a car — the bus stops outside our house.

cards.note: toast 是烤面包片。
used when you think about something that happened in the past
something that is not worth the money you pay for it
cards.tip: money 不可数，前面不加 a；结构同 a waste of time。
cards.example: That gym membership was a waste of money — I went twice.

cards.note: to have something as its material
也是「熨斗」：an iron；动词是「熨（衣服）」。
to manage to live or do something with the money or things you have
cards.tip: 靠什么过活用 on：get by on £20 a week；也说语言：get by in French（法语能凑合用）。
cards.example: I don't earn much, but I get by.

cards.text: get into the habit of doing
cards.note: to start doing something regularly so that it becomes a habit
cards.tip: of 后面接 doing；反过来「改掉习惯」是 get out of the habit of doing。
cards.example: I've got into the habit of walking to work.

cards.zh: 开始喜欢上；迷上（某爱好）
cards.note: to start to be interested in an activity
Monopoly（大富翁）、chess（国际象棋）都算 board games。
to want to do something, especially something you know you should not do
cards.tip: 后面接 to do；名词 temptation（诱惑）。
cards.example: I was tempted to leave early, but I stayed until the end.

cards.zh: 犒劳自己；给自己买点好的
cards.note: to buy or do something special for yourself that you enjoy
cards.tip: Go on 在这里是「去吧、来嘛」，劝别人做某事。
cards.example: You've worked hard all week — treat yourself to a takeaway.

cards.note: to keep money for a period of time so that you can buy something
cards.tip: up 强调「一点点攒起来」；也可以接 to do：save up to buy a car。
cards.example: She's saving up for a trip to Japan.

cards.note: to start a journey
女士的钱包英式也叫 purse。
